comment: Student at DePaul University pursuing a degree in Film Production and Cinematography. Seeking creative internships and storytelling opportunities to gain hands-on experience in production, development, and visual narrative. Aspires to become a creative director, designing and building immersive stories and experiences that connect with audiences.

Brought this world to life through the use of Blender and After effects. The memory splitting from the protagonists, and the dystopian world outside, was all created through after effects. First short I directed using vfx.

This story was inspired by the void scene from under the skin, and stranger things. I built an entire void set within a studio so that everything could be done practically, even the reflections, so that no vfx were used.
